stories.headline: Anthropic builds physical biology lab
stories.summary: Anthropic confirmed a Bay Area wet lab as it expands AI-assisted biology and preclinical work. It wants Claude to direct lab robots, but says human oversight is essential; drug-program success is uncertain.

stories.headline: Mantic raises $25 million for AI forecasting
stories.summary: Mantic raised $25 million after outperforming human entrants and all but one bot in a Metaculus forecasting contest. Its broader claims of “superhuman” forecasting remain based on limited competition evidence.

stories.headline: US weighs looser China pharma-deal rules
stories.summary: Treasury is drafting rules that would preserve most US licensing deals with Chinese drug developers while restricting pathogen or weaponizable biotechnology. Sources say the framework is unfinished and could change.

stories.headline: Nigeria investigates 37 custody deaths
stories.summary: Nigeria suspended a state paramilitary commander after 37 suspected illegal miners died in custody, prompting protests. Reuters filmed 33 bodies; the cause remains unknown pending medical examinations.

stories.headline: Yen falls despite Bank of Japan rate increase
stories.summary: The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25%, the highest in 31 years, but the yen fell as two policymakers dissented and guidance did not clearly signal further increases. Markets remain alert for intervention.
